These examples offer '''Original''' and '''Remastered''' renditions of the same English [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy|Original Virtual Set 1]] card publication. The matching publisher slip stays visible beneath either full card. Original is the historical [[Holotable]] composite; Remastered is a later [[Making Custom SWCCG Cards|CardMaker]] reconstruction.

The buttons below each card select its image for the current view. Use '''Card images''' above to save a default for future views. Signed-in readers save it with their account; guests save it in this browser. When only one matching rendition exists, that image appears without the pair of buttons.

== Examples ==
* [[SWCCG Wiki:Samples/Original Virtual Darth Vader image viewer|Darth Vader]] — Dark Side character.
* [[SWCCG Wiki:Samples/Original Virtual BoShek card images|BoShek]] — Light Side character.
* [[SWCCG Wiki:Samples/Original Virtual Blaster Rack card images|Blaster Rack]] — Dark Side Effect.

The [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy|set article]] and each published card article retain their existing publication history and version links.
